audience: e-commerce merchants who handle returns through Loop Returns

useCases.title: Review returns opened in the last day
useCases.text: List returns created or updated in a time range. Open one return to read its items, reasons and outcomes.

useCases.title: Check whether an order can still be returned
useCases.text: Check the return eligibility of each item in an order, by order name. The check starts no return.

useCases.title: Track return packages
useCases.text: List return packages with their tracking status in a date range. List Happy Returns drop-off shipments for the same period.

useCases.title: Read the notes on a return
useCases.text: Open one return and list its internal notes.

useCases.title: Add a note or flag a return for review
useCases.text: Add an internal note of up to 255 characters to a return. Flag a return to pause automated processing until a merchant reviews it.
